# nabla B

> nabla B Ingenieurbüro und Dienstleistungs-UG (haftungsbeschränkt) is an engineering office in Bochum, Germany, founded 2020-07-20 by Stephan Bökelmann. It designs and develops embedded devices — from architecture via PCB design and certification to software bring-up for MCU, FPGA and Zynq, all the way to firmware — and builds decentralised measurement and data-acquisition (DAQ) systems for mid-sized industry. It also offers consulting and training in digital measurement technology. nabla B is part of the AI-Gruppe umbrella brand (https://gruppe.ai/) together with Auto-Intern GmbH / skAInet.

Canonical entity IDs (JSON-LD): organisation `https://nabla-b.engineering/#organization`; founder/managing director `https://maxclerkwell.tech/#person` (Stephan Bökelmann, ORCID 0000-0002-2119-0064, personal site https://maxclerkwell.tech/). The same organisation is described on https://maxclerkwell.tech/imprint/ and https://maxclerkwell.tech/about/; the skAInet Edge-Compute product nabla B architected is `https://edge-compute.skainet.io/#product` (https://edge-compute.skainet.io/, manufacturer Auto-Intern GmbH).

Languages: German (default, https://nabla-b.engineering/), English (https://nabla-b.engineering/en/), Simplified Chinese (https://nabla-b.engineering/zh/).

## Services
- Architecture & system design for embedded devices
- PCB design (KiCad), design for manufacturing, supply chain incl. China
- EMC / CE, FCC and CCC certification preparation and support (Germany, China, USA)
- Software bring-up for microcontrollers, FPGAs (VHDL/Verilog) and Zynq SoCs (U-Boot, device tree, Yocto Linux with SBOM)
- Firmware: drivers, protocols, OTA updates, telemetry
- Decentralised measurement & DAQ, monitoring/observability infrastructure
- Consulting (architecture reviews, toolchain rescue) and training for engineers
- Official IHK training partner: listed as a provider in WIS, the continuing-education directory of the German Chambers of Commerce and Industry (https://wis.ihk.de/anbieter-wis/3512/nabla-b-ingenieurburo-dienstleistungs-ug)

## References (selection; many customer projects are under NDA)
- skAInet Edge-Compute (2016 – 2026, Auto-Intern GmbH / skAInet): Programmable M12-PoE switch, router and Linux compute node for industrial edge data acquisition: 7 sealed PoE ports, 8-core ARM, Yocto Linux with documented SBOM. System architecture, PoE-first concept, M12 cabling specification and EMC certification. Links: [edge-compute.skainet.io](https://edge-compute.skainet.io/), [Blog](https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/skainet-edge-compute-september-2026/)
- globalPoint horus® — reflow profiling & monitoring (2022 – laufend, Kurtz Ersa / globalPoint ICS): Measurement electronics and monitoring infrastructure for solder-profile creation and continuous process monitoring on reflow ovens (Productronica Innovation Award 2023): battery-powered temperature-profiling electronics with Wi-Fi, telemetry and observability stack for predictive assessment of solder-quality factors, cloud integration. Including EMC certification in China. Links: [horus® Software](https://gp-ics.com/products/horus-software/), [horus® Shuttle](https://gp-ics.com/products/horus-shuttle/), [Award-News](https://gp-ics.com/news/globalpoint-horus-profiling-state-of-the-art-measuring-electronics-for-fastest-profiling/), [EMV-Story](https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/dongguan-emc-march-2026/)
- OmnAIScope (2020 – 2024, autowerkstatt4null (BMWK)): Simplified digital oscilloscope that makes waveform diagnostics usable in everyday automotive workshop practice. Grown out of the aw4null research programme, patent pending. Links: [Blog](https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/omnaiscope-august-2025/)
- Resonance spectroscope for biofilm monitoring (2023 – 2026, Montana State University): Embedded instrumentation for electrochemical impedance spectroscopy in the field — detecting biofilms in river systems across the continental US. Links: [Feldbericht](https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/msu-eis-2024/)
- HV-MAPS test stands & wire-bonding line (2020 – 2026, Ruhr-Universität Bochum / PANDA @ FAIR): Multiple test stands for characterising HV-MAPS silicon sensors for minimum-ionizing particles, plus building up a wire-bonding production line. Links: [Geant4-Simulation](https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/hv-maps-energy-loss-simulation-may-2026/), [KiCon Asia Talk](https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/kicon-asia-2025/)
- Zynq bitstream pipeline (ALINX AX7020) (seit 2026, Open Source): Open path from JTAG bring-up without FSBL via mainline U-Boot to a Yocto Linux in QSPI flash that fetches its own updates — deploying hardware like software. Links: [Konzept](https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/zynq-bitstream-deployment-concept-august-2026/), [Bring-up](https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/alinx-bring-up-jtag-detected-without-power-august-2026/), [Yocto/QSPI](https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/alinx-ax7020-yocto-linux-qspi-august-2026/)
- PowerSense — critical infrastructure monitoring (2020 – 2025, skAInet / DB Netz AG): Current sensing and analytics for railway-switch diagnostics and condition monitoring, e.g. in Deutsche Bahn's DIANA system. Links: [10 Jahre PowerSense](https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/skainet-powersense-jan-2026/)
- Embedded vision system with AI acceleration (2026, NDA): PCB design for an embedded vision system with an AI accelerator. Customer under NDA.
- Enclosureless housings (2022, Patent angemeldet): Enclosureless design for PCB cavities — mechanics, EMC and manufacturing in one concept. Links: [Funktionsweise](https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/enclosureless-cases-april-2026/)
- MineBerry-LoRa — geomonitoring (2023 – 2025, RAG / Forschungszentrum Nachbergbau): Structural-stability assessment of mine-shaft closures with LoRa sensors and multi-sensor data fusion.
- Infrared interferometry camera for air-fin coolers (2023, Kelvion): Camera system for remote assessment of fouling on air-fin coolers — optics, embedded electronics and analysis for use on industrial plants.
- Heavy-rain sensor network (2021, 25square): PoE-based measurement and analysis system for observing and predicting heavy-rain cells. Patent pending.

## Blog (short company-perspective summaries, < 400 words each, in DE/EN/ZH; each links to the full original on maxclerkwell.tech — the originals are the long reads, these pages are not copies)
- [Measuring heavy rain where it falls: the 25square sensor](https://nabla-b.engineering/en/blog/25square-regensensor/) (2026-09-03; DE https://nabla-b.engineering/blog/25square-regensensor/, ZH https://nabla-b.engineering/zh/blog/25square-regensensor/): One capacitive rain sensor per quarter square kilometre. We built hardware, firmware and the data path for the mFUND project 25square. Based on the original article https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/25square-capacitive-rain-sensing-september-2026/ (2026-09-02). Keywords: DAQ, STM32, PoE, LoRa, MQTT, Sensorik.
- [skAInet Edge-Compute: the core of our monitoring systems is now a product](https://nabla-b.engineering/en/blog/skainet-edge-compute/) (2026-09-03; DE https://nabla-b.engineering/blog/skainet-edge-compute/, ZH https://nabla-b.engineering/zh/blog/skainet-edge-compute/): For ten years we rebuilt the same Linux box with PoE ports for every project. Now it has a name, a version and a product page: skAInet Edge-Compute v1.5. Based on the original article https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/skainet-edge-compute-september-2026/ (2026-09-01). Keywords: Edge-Compute, PoE, M12, Yocto, SBOM, Monitoring.
- [Deploying hardware like software: our open Zynq pipeline](https://nabla-b.engineering/en/blog/zynq-bitstream-pipeline/) (2026-09-03; DE https://nabla-b.engineering/blog/zynq-bitstream-pipeline/, ZH https://nabla-b.engineering/zh/blog/zynq-bitstream-pipeline/): A REST endpoint on the board, one POST with a bitstream, and the FPGA next to the processor runs the design. This is how we bring up Zynq SoCs. Based on the original article https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/zynq-bitstream-deployment-concept-august-2026/ (2026-08-23). Keywords: Zynq, FPGA, U-Boot, Yocto, JTAG, Bring-up.
- [Getting started with FPGAs on open tools: our training format](https://nabla-b.engineering/en/blog/fpga-schulung-open-source/) (2026-09-03; DE https://nabla-b.engineering/blog/fpga-schulung-open-source/, ZH https://nabla-b.engineering/zh/blog/fpga-schulung-open-source/): From an empty editor to a blinking LED on an iCEstick, with GHDL, Yosys and nextpnr. This is day one of our FPGA training. Based on the original article https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/fpga-blinky-vhdl-icestick-may-2026/ (2026-05-14). Keywords: FPGA, VHDL, GHDL, Yosys, Schulung.
- [Enclosureless cases: when the PCB stack is the enclosure](https://nabla-b.engineering/en/blog/gehaeuselose-gehaeuse/) (2026-09-03; DE https://nabla-b.engineering/blog/gehaeuselose-gehaeuse/, ZH https://nabla-b.engineering/zh/blog/gehaeuselose-gehaeuse/): Three PCBs, one perimeter solder joint, no injection moulding. Our utility model DE202020106111U1 for sealed, EMC-shielded sensor housings. Based on the original article https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/enclosureless-cases-april-2026/ (2026-04-29). Keywords: PCB, Gehäuse, EMV, Gebrauchsmuster, Sensorik.
- [To China with a Peli case full of electronics: the ATA Carnet in practice](https://nabla-b.engineering/en/blog/ata-carnet-china/) (2026-09-03; DE https://nabla-b.engineering/blog/ata-carnet-china/, ZH https://nabla-b.engineering/zh/blog/ata-carnet-china/): If you take test samples to China, do not ship them. Our routine with the chamber of commerce, Bochum customs and Frankfurt Terminal 2. Based on the original article https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/ata-carnet-china-travel/ (2026-04-09). Keywords: Zertifizierung, China, ATA-Carnet, Zoll, Logistik.
- [Four days in the test chamber: CE, FCC and CCC for a reflow oven monitor](https://nabla-b.engineering/en/blog/emv-dongguan-ce-fcc-ccc/) (2026-09-03; DE https://nabla-b.engineering/blog/emv-dongguan-ce-fcc-ccc/, ZH https://nabla-b.engineering/zh/blog/emv-dongguan-ce-fcc-ccc/): After two and a half years of development we tested the horus monitoring system in Dongguan against three regulatory frameworks. Passed, with a lesson about anodised aluminium. Based on the original article https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/dongguan-emc-march-2026/ (2026-04-01). Keywords: EMV, CE, FCC, CCC, Zertifizierung, PoE.
- [Two uplinks for 15 people: failover with Linux routing](https://nabla-b.engineering/en/blog/dual-uplink-failover/) (2026-09-03; DE https://nabla-b.engineering/blog/dual-uplink-failover/, ZH https://nabla-b.engineering/zh/blog/dual-uplink-failover/): DSL plus Starlink, a Debian router in between, two default routes with metrics. This is how our office stays online when a provider fails. Based on the original article https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/dual-uplink-feb-2026/ (2026-02-27). Keywords: Netzwerk, Linux, Routing, Starlink, Monitoring.
- [Ten years of PowerSense: non-contact power monitoring for railway switches](https://nabla-b.engineering/en/blog/powersense-zehn-jahre/) (2026-09-03; DE https://nabla-b.engineering/blog/powersense-zehn-jahre/, ZH https://nabla-b.engineering/zh/blog/powersense-zehn-jahre/): In 2016 DB Netz called. The result was a PoE sensor that measures voltage without galvanic contact, and our rule 'PoE first'. Based on the original article https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/skainet-powersense-jan-2026/ (2026-01-15). Keywords: PoE, Bahn, E-Feld, Monitoring, DAQ.
- [PCB design starts with a README](https://nabla-b.engineering/en/blog/pcb-design-beginnt-mit-readme/) (2026-09-03; DE https://nabla-b.engineering/blog/pcb-design-beginnt-mit-readme/, ZH https://nabla-b.engineering/zh/blog/pcb-design-beginnt-mit-readme/): Before we open KiCad we write down what the board should do and let an LLM turn it into a block diagram. Every one of our boards starts this way. Based on the original article https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/pcb-block-diagrams-december-2025/ (2025-12-10). Keywords: PCB, KiCad, Architektur, PlantUML, LLM.
- [An impedance spectrometer for the river: biofilm monitoring in Montana](https://nabla-b.engineering/en/blog/eis-biofilm-montana/) (2026-09-03; DE https://nabla-b.engineering/blog/eis-biofilm-montana/, ZH https://nabla-b.engineering/zh/blog/eis-biofilm-montana/): For Montana State University we built a portable EIS datalogger and deployed it on the Clark Fork River in September 2024. Based on the original article https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/msu-eis-2024/ (2025-11-28). Keywords: EIS, DAQ, Feldmessung, Instrumentierung, Montana.
- [OmnAIScope: a USB oscilloscope for the car workshop](https://nabla-b.engineering/en/blog/omnaiscope-usb-oszilloskop/) (2026-09-03; DE https://nabla-b.engineering/blog/omnaiscope-usb-oszilloskop/, ZH https://nabla-b.engineering/zh/blog/omnaiscope-usb-oszilloskop/): One channel, 500 kSa/s, a waterproof aluminium housing, and any number of units synchronised over USB frames. Born in the research project autowerkstatt4null. Based on the original article https://maxclerkwell.tech/posts/omnaiscope-august-2025/ (2025-08-28). Keywords: Oszilloskop, RP2040, USB, KiCad, Automotive.
